about.title: About me
about.text: Hey! I'm PlaywithK, the creator of this website.

webgames.title: Web games
webgames.desc: Here you can find some small web games I built as little tests with HTML, CSS and JavaScript. Have fun playing!

apps.title: App development
apps.desc: It always bothered me to have 20 apps on my phone for every single feature. So I decided to create my own app that brings all functions together in one place. Chorez was born.

games.title: Game development
games.desc: I've wanted to develop my own games for years, and the ideas in my head have been constantly overflowing. Here you'll find everything about my dev journey and my current game projects.
